clusters.pick_reason: #2215 is a strict superset of #2214's changes: it applies the same `/\/+$/` regex in both discovery functions, but also (1) extracts a reusable `normalizeDiscoveryPath` helper to avoid the duplicated logic, and (2) fixes a latent bug in `shouldAttemptFallback` — after normalization, a root path becomes `''` not `'/'`, so #2214's unchanged guard `pathname === '/'` would never fire, allowing unnecessary 4xx/502 fallback retries on root paths. #2215 corrects this by checking `pathname === ''`.
